mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_index_job(event_id) SELECT event_id FROM ma_outbox WHERE aggregate_type = 'SOURCE' AND kind IN ('SOURCE_VERSION_CREATED','SOURCE_REINDEX','SOURCE_WITHDRAWN') AND status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_index_job j WHERE j.event_id = ma_outbox.event_id) ORDER BY created_at,event_id LIMIT 100 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH chosen AS ( SELECT j.event_id FROM ma_index_job j JOIN ma_outbox e USING(event_id) WHERE e.aggregate_type = 'SOURCE' AND e.status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND (j.status = 'PROCESSING' OR (j.status = 'PENDING' AND j.attempts < 3)) AND j.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (j.status != 'PROCESSING' OR j.lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY e.created_at,e.event_id FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ), claimed AS ( UPDATE ma_index_job SET status = 'PROCESSING', fence = fence + 1, attempts = LEAST(attempts + 1, 4), lease_until = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes' WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM chosen) RETURNING event_id,fence,attempts ) SELECT e.*,c.fence,c.attempts,j.call_state,j.index_protocol FROM claimed c JOIN ma_outbox e USING(event_id) JOIN ma_index_job j USING(event_id)
SELECT account_id FROM app_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT event_id FROM ma_index_job WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FOR UPDATE
SELECT index_protocol FROM ma_index_job WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE ma_index_job SET index_protocol = #{protocol} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND call_state = 'NOT_SENT' AND (index_protocol IS NULL OR index_protocol = #{protocol}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_outbox e JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = e.aggregate_id AND s.account_id = e.account_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = e.aggregate_version WHERE e.event_id = ma_index_job.event_id AND e.aggregate_type = 'SOURCE' AND e.kind IN ('SOURCE_VERSION_CREATED','SOURCE_REINDEX') AND s.type = 'SAVED_ANSWER' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.current_version = e.aggregate_version AND v.status = 'INDEX_PENDING' AND v.index_revision = e.index_revision AND v.content_sha256 = e.payload_digest)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ma_index_stage WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND call_state != 'CONFIRMED'

SELECT event_id,phase,ordinal,account_id,source_id,source_version,index_revision, source_sha256,file_ref,input_sha256,model,dimensions,schema_version,call_state, intent_fence,output_json,output_sha256,request_count,total_tokens FROM ma_index_stage WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND phase = #{phase} AND ordinal = #{ordinal}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_index_stage(event_id,phase,ordinal,account_id,source_id,source_version, index_revision,source_sha256,file_ref,input_sha256,model,dimensions,schema_version, call_state,intent_fence) SELECT #{eventId},#{phase},#{ordinal},#{accountId},#{sourceId},#{version}, #{indexRevision},#{sourceSha256},#{fileRef,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{inputSha256}, #{model},#{dimensions},#{schemaVersion},'CALL_INTENT',#{fence} WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_index_job j WHERE j.event_id = #{eventId} AND j.fence = #{fence} AND j.status = 'PROCESSING' AND j.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j.index_protocol = 'HANDWRITING_METHODS_V1') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_outbox e JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = e.aggregate_id AND s.account_id = e.account_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = e.aggregate_version WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId} AND e.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.source_id = #{sourceId} AND s.type = 'SAVED_ANSWER' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.current_version = #{version} AND v.status = 'INDEX_PENDING' AND v.index_revision = #{indexRevision} AND e.index_revision = #{indexRevision} AND v.content_sha256 = #{sourceSha256} AND e.payload_digest = #{sourceSha256} AND v.file_ref IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{fileRef,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (event_id,phase,ordinal) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: WITH changed AS ( UPDATE ma_index_stage SET call_state = 'UNKNOWN' WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND call_state = 'CALL_INTENT' RETURNING event_id ) UPDATE ma_index_job SET usage_uncertain = TRUE WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM changed)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ma_index_stage stage JOIN ma_outbox e ON e.event_id = stage.event_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = stage.source_id AND v.version = stage.source_version WHERE stage.event_id = #{eventId} AND (stage.account_id != e.account_id OR stage.source_id != e.aggregate_id OR stage.source_version != e.aggregate_version OR stage.index_revision != e.index_revision OR stage.source_sha256 != e.payload_digest OR stage.source_sha256 != v.content_sha256 OR stage.file_ref IS DISTINCT FROM v.file_ref OR (stage.phase = 'EMBED_BATCH' AND (stage.model != #{model} OR stage.dimensions != #{dimensions})))

SELECT event_id,phase,ordinal,account_id,source_id,source_version,index_revision, source_sha256,file_ref,input_sha256,model,dimensions,schema_version,call_state, intent_fence,output_json,output_sha256,request_count,total_tokens FROM ma_index_stage WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND phase = 'EMBED_BATCH' AND call_state = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ma_index_stage WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND phase = 'OCR_STEP' AND call_state = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ma_retrieval_chunk WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_retrieval_chunk(chunk_id,account_id,source_id,version,anchor_id,question_id, text,method_tags,terms,embedding,embedding_model,dimensions,index_revision,method_metadata) VALUES(#{id},#{accountId},#{sourceId},#{version},#{anchorId},#{questionId},#{text}, CAST(#{methodTags} AS jsonb),CAST(#{terms} AS jsonb),CAST(#{vector} AS vector), #{model},#{dimensions},#{indexRevision},CAST(#{methodMetadata,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE ma_index_job SET status = 'DONE',completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,failure_reason = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE ma_index_job SET status = 'FAILED',failure_reason = #{reason}, attempts = attempts - CASE WHEN #{reason} = 'EMBEDDING_DISABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, usage_uncertain = usage_uncertain OR call_state = 'CALL_INTENT' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_index_stage st WHERE st.event_id = ma_index_job.event_id AND st.call_state IN ('CALL_INTENT','UNKNOWN')), next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '60 seconds' WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE ma_index_job SET lease_until = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes' WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE ma_index_job j SET call_state = 'CALL_INTENT' WHERE j.event_id = #{eventId} AND j.fence = #{fence} AND j.status = 'PROCESSING' AND j.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j.index_protocol IS NULL AND j.call_state IN ('NOT_SENT','CONFIRMED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ma_outbox e JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = e.aggregate_id AND s.account_id = e.account_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = e.aggregate_version WHERE e.event_id = j.event_id AND e.aggregate_type = 'SOURCE' AND e.kind IN ('SOURCE_VERSION_CREATED','SOURCE_REINDEX') AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.current_version = e.aggregate_version AND v.status = 'INDEX_PENDING' AND v.index_revision = e.index_revision)
UPDATE ma_index_job SET call_state = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND call_state = 'CALL_INTENT'

UPDATE ma_index_job SET ocr_calls = ocr_calls + #{ocrCalls}, embedding_requests = embedding_requests + #{embeddingRequests}, embedding_tokens = CASE WHEN #{tokens,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL THEN embedding_tokens ELSE COALESCE(embedding_tokens,0) + #{tokens,jdbcType=BIGINT} END, usage_uncertain = usage_uncertain OR #{uncertain} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND fence = #{fence} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ma_query_embedding(step_id,account_id,run_id,query_sha256, embedding_model,dimensions,call_state) SELECT step.step_id,r.account_id,r.run_id,#{querySha256},#{model},#{dimensions},'CALL_INTENT' FROM ma_step step JOIN ma_run r ON r.run_id = step.run_id JOIN ma_request req ON req.request_id = r.request_id AND req.account_id = r.account_id WHERE step.step_id = #{stepId} AND step.role = 'RETRIEVE' AND r.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.run_id = #{runId} AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND req.current_run_id = r.run_id AND step.sequence = (SELECT MAX(latest.sequence) FROM ma_step latest WHERE latest.run_id = r.run_id AND latest.role = 'RETRIEVE') ON CONFLICT (step_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: FROM ma_retrieval_chunk c JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = c.source_id AND s.account_id = c.account_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = c.version JOIN ma_anchor a ON a.anchor_id = c.anchor_id AND a.source_id = c.source_id AND a.version = c.version WHERE c.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.current_version = c.version AND v.status = 'READY' AND v.index_revision = c.index_revision AND s.type IN ('QUESTION','SAVED_ANSWER','NOTE','TUTOR_REPLY') AND c.embedding_model = #{model} AND c.dimensions = #{dimensions}
mapper.select:
WITH authorized AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT c.*,s.type,v.answer_state,a.content_sha256 AS anchor_sha256, lower(regexp_replace(normalize(c.text, NFKC), '[[:space:]]+', '', 'g')) AS method_text, CASE WHEN s.type = 'TUTOR_REPLY' THEN ( SELECT reply_request.question_id::text FROM ma_result reply_result JOIN ma_run reply_run ON reply_run.run_id = reply_result.run_id JOIN ma_request reply_request ON reply_request.request_id = reply_run.request_id AND reply_request.account_id = reply_run.account_id WHERE reply_result.result_id = s.origin_id AND reply_run.account_id = s.account_id LIMIT 1 ) ELSE c.question_id END AS actual_question_id
), scores AS ( SELECT *,1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)) AS vector_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(terms) term WHERE jsonb_exists(CAST(#{terms} AS jsonb), term)) + 3 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_each(CAST(#{methodAliases} AS jsonb)) query_method WHERE CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(CAST(#{literalPatterns} AS jsonb), query_method.key) THEN method_text ~ (CAST(#{literalPatterns} AS jsonb) -> query_method.key ->> 'positive') AND method_text !~ (CAST(#{literalPatterns} AS jsonb) -> query_method.key ->> 'negative') ELSE jsonb_exists(method_tags, query_method.key) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(query_method.value) method_alias(value) WHERE strpos(method_text, method_alias.value) > 0 ) END) + CASE WHEN #{handwritingRecallEnabled} = TRUE AND type = 'SAVED_ANSWER' AND method_metadata IS NOT NULL AND method_metadata ->> 'formatVersion' = '1' AND method_metadata ->> 'accountId' = account_id::text AND method_metadata ->> 'sourceId' = source_id AND method_metadata ->> 'sourceVersion' = version::text AND method_metadata ->> 'indexRevision' = index_revision::text AND method_metadata ->> 'anchorId' = anchor_id AND method_metadata ->> 'anchorSha256' = anchor_sha256 AND method_metadata -> 'result' ->> 'schemaVersion' = 'handwriting-ocr-v1' AND method_metadata -> 'result' ->> 'taxonomyVersion' = 'math-methods-v1' AND method_metadata -> 'result' ->> 'uncertainty' = 'CLEAR' AND jsonb_typeof(method_metadata -> 'result' -> 'methodCandidates') = 'array' THEN 3 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT candidate ->> 'method') FROM jsonb_array_elements(method_metadata -> 'result' -> 'methodCandidates') candidate WHERE candidate ->> 'state' = 'CANDIDATE' AND candidate ->> 'reason' = 'VISIBLE_STEPS' AND jsonb_exists(CAST(#{inferredMethodTags} AS jsonb), candidate ->> 'method')) ELSE 0 END AS lexical_score FROM authorized ), picked AS ( (SELECT chunk_id FROM scores ORDER BY vector_score DESC,chunk_id LIMIT 40) UNION (SELECT chunk_id FROM scores WHERE lexical_score > 0 ORDER BY lexical_score DESC,chunk_id LIMIT 40) ) SELECT account_id,source_id,version,index_revision,anchor_id,anchor_sha256, type,actual_question_id AS question_id,answer_state,text, method_tags::text AS method_tags,method_metadata::text AS method_metadata, vector_score,lexical_score FROM scores WHERE chunk_id IN (SELECT chunk_id FROM picked) ORDER BY lexical_score DESC,vector_score DESC,chunk_id

SELECT step.step_id FROM ma_step step JOIN ma_run r ON r.run_id = step.run_id JOIN ma_request req ON req.request_id = r.request_id AND req.account_id = r.account_id WHERE r.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.run_id = #{runId} AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND req.current_run_id = r.run_id AND step.role = 'RETRIEVE' ORDER BY step.sequence DESC LIMIT 1
